TGO.note: No rule or authority on AI harms stated.
No government body AI system in use or piloted is stated.
Togo AI Lab is said to support decisions in several sectors, but no specific AI tool in a sector's system is stated.

facts.fact: Togo AI Lab, with Zindi and the Togolese startup Umbaji, is building an open-source platform to collect voice and text data, aiming for at least 50 hours of validated recordings and 6,000 translated sentence pairs for each of 50 national languages, to train speech recognition, speech synthesis and translation models, as presented at AI for Good in July 2026.
facts.system: Togo AI Lab national languages project
